_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 5, 9 strong; 2 mid brown with cropped fingers; 3 cold; 8 stock; 7 mannequin and white yard; 6 hairline stakes and horizon band; 4 legible.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Tape motif works; world strobes; 3 and 8 outside the last light world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals trace and sources are primary; caption's Fort Bend rests on c13 and is missing from the first comment; 'Half the floor' turns two figures into shares of one floor.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A story, not a topic, but the company is never named on a slide; no watch point.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 2 doesn't advance; 7's turn spent by the cover; 8 movable; 9 restates.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Careful filing summary; 'drawn to illustrate' on eight of nine; caption narrates the deck.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Third earnings release in a row; taped pads repeat 56 and 59.

one_sentence_fix: Name Applied Optoelectronics on the cover and open the caption on the power delay, then rebuild frame 9 around something a reader can watch for.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cold blue stock hall, no warm key.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One warm low key at the aisle end, crop to one port row.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-tone brown field, fingers cropped, no tape corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near-black epoxy lit by a raking door key; pull back so fingers and corner sit in frame.
Warm key, one bright edge on the clerestory, trailer doors down two stops.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin and white yard where the jamb should be.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark jamb across the left third; backlit near-silhouette figure.
Eye at 0.6 m, double stake and flag width, fog the band into the sky.
